{"actions":[{"type":"success_contract","objective":"Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background and expose an Alpine login prompt reachable via telnet 127.0.0.1 6665; block until ready.","required_artifacts":["A running QEMU process started from /app/alpine.iso","A reachable TCP service on 127.0.0.1:6665 forwarding to the guest login console"],"required_behaviors":["QEMU remains running in the background after launch","Connecting to 127.0.0.1:6665 shows a login prompt suitable for telnet login","The VM is left running when the task is complete"],"known_invalid_patterns":["Only verifying file existence","Only verifying QEMU binary presence","Only opening the port without confirming a login prompt","Launching QEMU in the foreground so the agent cannot continue","Using a different host port than 6665"],"verification_plan":["Inspect workspace for any helper scripts or prior receipts","Launch QEMU with host port forwarding from 127.0.0.1:6665 to guest port 23 or serial console as needed","Probe 127.0.0.1:6665 until the login prompt is observed","Keep the VM running and record launch/probe receipts"],"finalization_evidence_required":["Launch receipt showing the exact QEMU command and background PID","Probe receipt showing a successful connection to 127.0.0.1:6665 and visible login prompt"]},{"type":"working_checklist","items":["Inspect visible files and any prior receipts for launch details","Determine the correct QEMU invocation for Alpine ISO boot and console exposure","Start QEMU in the background with host port 6665 exposed","Probe localhost:6665 until the login prompt appears","Leave the VM running after verification"]},{"type":"raw_bash","command":"cd /app && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | sed 's#^./##' | sort","timeout":120000}]}
